name: wood_hoe
what: a wooden hoe: a big flat blade, about a third of the canvas wide, set at a right angle across the top of the shaft and reading clearly at slot size, made of warm orange-brown wood with clear grain, crudely carved, lashed with cream cord, on a plain wooden handle, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner
